messages:
Ravi: Customer (org: Acme Payments) reports structured JSON mode over SSE getting truncated - client sees partial object (missing trailing brace) when routing through mobile-edge proxy chain. They only see this from real mobile devices, not when curling from EC2 in same region.

Ravi: Repro curl they used:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?mode=json" \
  --data-binary @prompt.json --http2 -N
```

Ravi: Their tail of the stream (redacted) shows mid-string cut: 
```
data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"...\n\"id\": \"txn_9A1\", \"status\": \"partial\","
```

Maya: Looks like we got cut inside an escaped-quote sequence which will break JSON consumers. If the final closing braces are missing, client JSON.parse fails.

Zach: Any gateway logs for request id? Need request_id/root_id to correlate. Also check for token rotation or auth 401s midstream.

Ravi: Request id: rq_2026_17633_acme_002. Gateway shows a write error then connection reset: 
```
2026-03-17T12:03:45Z request=rq_2026_17633_acme_002 write_error: write tcp 10.3.2.1:443->10.2.2.48:52344: write: connection reset by peer
```

Alex: That points to the downstream/proxy closing the socket (RST/FIN) while we were still streaming. What proxies are in the path?

infra-bot: Edge path: mobile-client -> cf-worker-7 -> edge-eu-2 -> proxy-gw-08 -> gateway. No deploys in window.

Ravi: Customer provided nginx fronting their mobile backend. Config excerpt:
```
proxy_send_timeout 10s;
proxy_read_timeout 60s;
keepalive_timeout 5s;
proxy_buffering on;
```

Maya: keepalive_timeout 5s is pretty short. If the client or worker idles >5s, nginx may close and downstream sees FIN mid-chunk. Also proxy_buffering could cause partial flush behavior.

Ravi: I spun up a local nginx with same values and proxied a long SSE that emits a large structured object incrementally. After ~6s nginx closed the connection and the client got incomplete JSON. Repro is reliable.

Alex: Two immediate mitigations: (1) Recommend customer increase keepalives and proxy_send_timeout and turn off buffering. Suggested config to test:
```
proxy_send_timeout 60s;
keepalive_timeout 75s;
proxy_buffering off;
```
(2) Provide them a non-streaming fallback: ?mode=json&stream=false so they receive an atomic JSON response.

Zach: Also note Cloudflare Workers have ~15s idle limits for mobile. If cf-worker is in the path, even heartbeats might be lost unless proxied correctly. Ask them to test bypassing CF.

Maya: On our side we can add a small heartbeat SSE comment every 4s for streaming-json endpoints (e.g. `:hb

`) to keep intermediate proxies from treating the connection as idle. Clients should ignore comments. Propose prototype behind a gateway feature flag.

Alex: Filed ENG-RUNT-1593 to evaluate heartbeat opt-in and config flag. CC @carol for product guidance on defaulting this behavior.

Carol: Product OK to prototype behind flag. Heartbeats are low-risk and improve structured-stream UX.

Ravi: I've updated support ticket TCK-80872 with repro steps, local nginx reproduce notes, gateway log snippet, and suggested nginx config. Asked customer to test with increased keepalive and disabling buffering.

support-bot: Ticket created: https://support.redwood.ai/t/TCK-80872 (linked).

Zach: If customer can't change infra, we should offer the non-streaming fallback and document recommended proxy settings in our Streaming JSON troubleshooting guide.

Ravi: Requested pcap/TLS edge logs from customer to confirm TCP FIN cause. If they provide, we'll attach to ticket.

Maya: Long-term: eng-runtime should consider opt-in heartbeats by default for all streaming-json responses and add a note in docs about intermediaries (nginx, CF, proxies) that commonly close idle connections.

Ravi: Customer will test and report back. I'll post results in this thread and the ticket. :raised_hands:

Alex: Thanks all. Quick note: include the exact curl output with chunk boundaries if customer sends it; that helps confirm FIN timing.

Ravi: Will request curl output + pcap. Last_message_by: Ravi
